Worker bee filtration capacity can be overwhelmed by accumulated pesticides
Severely contaminated eggs may fail to develop properly
Study used nanocolonies with one queen and 60 worker bees each

title: NASA's FALCON System Successfully Navigates Satellites Without GPS Using Orbital Debris as Reference Points
summary: NASA demonstrates autonomous satellite navigation without GPS by using other spacecraft and orbital debris as landmarks, improving orbits of 200+ objects in three days.
updatesTitle: NASA satellites successfully navigate without GPS using alternative methods

title: Genetic predisposition determines low-carb diet's effect on LDL cholesterol
summary: People with genetic susceptibility to high cholesterol experience sharper LDL spikes on low-carb diets high in saturated fat, explaining variable dietary outcomes.

title: NASA study finds Earth microbes could survive on lunar surface
summary: NASA researchers determine that microbes transported by astronauts could survive in cold, shadowed regions near the Moon's South Pole, complicating future searches for pristine lunar chemistry.

title: Backyard bird feeders pose H5N1 transmission risk during Australian outbreak
summary: Backyard bird feeders could become hotspots for H5N1 transmission as Australia's bird flu outbreak spreads, bringing species together in unnatural concentrations.

title: TOFA compound burns fat without muscle loss in mice, improves metabolic markers
summary: An experimental compound called TOFA increased energy use by up to 18% in mice, reducing body fat without significant muscle loss while improving blood sugar and triglyceride levels.

title: China delays Chang'e 7 lunar south pole mission due to weather
summary: China postponed its Chang'e 7 mission to the Moon's south pole because of severe weather near the launch site.

title: Yeast beta-glucan shown to enhance cancer-fighting immune response in mice
summary: A yeast-based supplement containing beta-glucan reprogrammed immune cells in bone marrow to generate stronger, longer-lasting cancer-fighting responses in mice.

title: Microsoft Research and CASUS partner on AI for quantum chemistry calculations
summary: A new AI model designed to improve quantum chemistry calculations is now available through a partnership between CASUS and Microsoft Research.

title: Study finds fungal toxins in all 212 plant-based meat alternatives tested
summary: A UK study found that all 212 plant-based meat alternatives examined contained at least one naturally occurring fungal toxin, though levels remained below EU guideline limits.

title: Multilingual speakers show brain age 13 years younger than monolinguals
summary: People fluent in multiple languages show brains aged about 13 years younger than monolingual speakers, with effects stronger in those who became fluent earlier.

title: Vitamin D supplementation linked to 13% cognitive score improvement in older adults
summary: Older adults with mild cognitive impairment who took at least 5,000 IU of vitamin D daily scored 13% higher on cognitive tests than those taking none.
